label: Bible Study
prompt: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an _____ spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
verse: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
note: Daniel's excellence made the other officials jealous — and that's how the lions' den came about.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wherefore _____ one another with these words.
verse: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
note: Paul writes about the Lord's return for believers who've died, then says: comfort one another with these words.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee _____. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verse: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
note: 'Thy faith hath made thee whole' — and the first thing Bartimaeus did with his new sight was follow Jesus.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But Jonah rose up to _____ unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
verse: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
note: Sent to Nineveh, Jonah booked passage the other way, to Tarshish — paid the fare and everything.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he shall be thy _____ unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
verse: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
note: God's compromise for a reluctant Moses: Aaron would be his 'spokesman' — the only time the KJV uses the word.
